'''Flern''' is a Seanchan man seen by [[Aviendha]] in the [[Glass columns]] of [[Rhuidean]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Flern}}

He is laying a railway line across the Waste when [[Malidra]] tried to take food from his trash. He shot and killed her as he considered Aiel to be vermin.
